title: Chat pane (Claude Code stream)
summary: The terminal dock Chat tab: Claude Code run in stream-JSON mode with the app MCP server attached; messages, tool chips and allow/deny permission cards stream in over a WebSocket, with a permission-mode select and a hand-off to a Claude Code terminal tab. From formlit.
description: Built once; messages and tool chips are appended and status text is patched in place. Talks to the engine through the /api/agent/claude routes (`routers/claude_code.py`, slot `svc.claude-code-agents`) via the app api client (`claudeStatus`, `claudeStart`, `claudeSend`, `claudeStop`, `claudeAllow`) and the stream `/agent/claude/stream`. B06 lists `services/llm.py` beside this file, but chat-pane.ts does not use it: llm.py is the separate assistant provider service, so it is not part of this slot. Imports ../io/api and ./i18n (not seeded).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.doc: The dock's Chat tab: Claude Code run in stream-JSON mode with formvis's MCP server attached, its messages streamed in from the engine. Built once; messages, tool chips and permission cards are appended, status text is patched in place.
True while a turn is running.
Marks the pane wanted, connects the stream socket and refreshes status.
Marks the pane unwanted and closes the stream socket.
Sends the text as the next turn, starting Claude Code first if it is not running; ignored while busy.

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
User-visible strings go through t() from the i18n module; the English text is the key.
Icons are inline currentColor SVG strings from the icons module (icon(name, size)); no icon library, and the three-star sparkle icon is banned under any name.
A tool the agent wants to run that needs consent is shown as an allow or deny card, and the click is answered through the engine (claudeAllow).
